proof_0409.moves: Pure definitional unfolding: the value of expMap at a coordinate is by construction the stated expression, so the proof is rfl. No mathematical step beyond unfolding the definition of expMap and its partial-homeomorph coercion.

proof_0410.moves: The coercion of the constant modular form is the constant function, true by definition; the proof is Eq.refl. Everything else is the ambient level-subgroup / weight typing needed to state it.

proof_0411.moves: Commute the product (p * X = X * p) and invoke the already-proved splits_X_mul; the only real content is commutativity of multiplication in the polynomial ring, the rest is simp closing an iff.

proof_0412.moves: Identical distribution is preserved under composition with a fixed measurable map; here the map is x -> c + x, whose measurability comes from the MeasurableAdd hypothesis.

proof_0413.moves: Transfer smoothness of the complex exponential to the real line: Complex.exp is C^infinity, and a complex-differentiable map restricted along the real embedding is real-smooth.

proof_0414.moves: Split the iff into two directions: forward, a conjugate root over a normal extension is realized by some algebra automorphism; backward, applying any algebra equivalence to a root produces a conjugate root (with a symm to orient it). The existential in the backward direction is destructured.

proof_0415.moves: Negation is a measurable map, and precomposing an a.e.-measurable function with (in fact postcomposing by) a measurable map keeps it a.e.-measurable.

proof_0416.moves: Turn the existing extensionality lemma into an iff: one direction is the ext lemma, the other is substituting the equality of maps and closing by rfl. Pure logical packaging of an already-proved fact.

proof_0417.moves: The preservation of one pullback cone gives preservation of the symmetric one; the proof just transports the existing instance across the symmetry of the pullback square for the forgetful functor to Top.

proof_0418.moves: Meromorphy is a pointwise condition, so unfold to each point and apply the local (MeromorphicAt) quotient rule. No global argument at all.

proof_0419.moves: The trivialization at a point is by definition the local trivialization at the index chosen for that point, so the statement is the already-proved localTriv_symmL specialized to indexAt x.

proof_0420.moves: Reduce global smoothness to smoothness at every point via contDiff_iff_contDiffAt, then apply the pointwise product-map result at each point of the product; the rewriting is Eq.mpr/propext bookkeeping.

proof_0421.moves: The construction packages a measurable rational CDF; feed the verified IsMeasurableRatCDF instance for toRatCDF into the general nonnegativity of the associated Stieltjes function.

proof_0422.moves: The representative is defined by choice from the existence lemma, so the statement is exactly Exists.choose_spec of that lemma. Choosing a witness and reading off its defining property is the entire proof.

proof_0423.moves: At exponent infinity the eLpNorm is the essential sup, so the statement is the already-proved essential-sup formula for a piecewise function transported through that identification.

proof_0424.moves: The coercion from the reals to the extended reals is measurable, so composing it with an a.e.-measurable function preserves a.e.-measurability.

proof_0425.moves: Specialize the filter-basis characterization of membership in the measure support to the tautological basis of the neighborhood filter, turning 'some basis element' into 'every neighborhood'.

proof_0426.moves: Cast the natural number to an integer and apply the integer version of the comparison; the only step is that the nat cast into the reals factors through the int cast.

proof_0427.moves: The finite measure attached to a probability measure carries the same underlying set function, so the coercion statement holds by definition; the proof is rfl.

proof_0428.moves: The quotient map is surjective and continuous (continuity is immediate for the coinduced topology), and the continuous surjective image of a path-connected space is path-connected.

proof_0429.moves: Build the NormOneClass instance by checking its single field: the unit of the continuous-linear-map algebra is the identity operator, whose operator norm is 1 (needing the space to be nontrivial).

proof_0430.moves: The interior is open and contained in the null set, hence itself null by monotonicity; an open null set is empty for an open-positive measure.

proof_0431.moves: Swap of a product is a measurable equivalence, and comap along an equivalence is map along its inverse; instantiate the general comap/symm lemma at prodComm.

proof_0432.moves: Rewrite the integral over the preimage set: use that the map is measure-preserving so the pushforward measure is the target measure, that restriction commutes with pushforward along a measurable embedding, and finally the change-of-variables formula for lintegral along a measurable embedding.
